question: What happens when linguistic conventions become rooted in innate phonemic consciousness?
premises: There is an uncontrived consciousness of infinite phonemes.
Linguistic conventions can become firmly established in that consciousness.
When so established, those conventions attain a non-conventional mode of operation.
inference: Conventions grounded in innate phonemic consciousness transcend mere conventionality in their operation.
plain_english: If linguistic conventions become firmly established in this uncontrived consciousness of infinite phonemes, then even they come to operate in a non-conventional way.
